facts: Upper-left fuel WARNING says avoid prolonged use with the last segment blinking and refuel at the earliest; failure can strand the rider and seriously damage the fuel pump.
The lower-left CHARGER PORT heading and handlebar illustration describe the separate USB port.
Right-hand USB WARNING recommends avoiding rainy charging; mobile phones only and one at a time; proper insertion; unused cap not open or partly closed; no metal/conductive material in the port.
independent_visual_findings.heading: OPERATION OF CONTROLS
independent_visual_findings.separate_context: The upper-left fuel warning is a different subsection from USB charging despite sharing the page.

facts: Charging only, no data transfer; constant charging only, not fast/dash, with performance not assumed equivalent to an original phone charger.
Charging duration can be longer and varies with phone make, battery capacity, state of charge and charging circuitry; no exact duration is supplied.
Above2.5A current shuts the charger down; check phone battery current ratings before use.
USB charging requires the engine to be running; use standard approved/high-quality USB cables.
CAUTION says close and lock the unused USB cap properly and explains damaged/unsealed cap warranty limits.
independent_visual_findings.heading: OPERATION OF CONTROLS / USB NOTE and CAUTION
